operation: Same 100-entry restart/random interpret_batch; real native baseline artifact and real validation/atomic append in an isolated baseline clone. Only post-append scheduling suppressed; live target histories untouched.

equivalence.paired_sample: Exact prepared contexts, catalog availability, witnesses and command payloads; normalize generated IDs only. Same immutable artifact used for both modules.
equivalence.full_operation: All 100 canonical facts match original run; exclude generated IDs/time/revision and optional non-identity row_index fields. Interpretation evidence, question, reason, status and subject match separately, excluding fixture-specific subject_revision.
equivalence.history: Original MAL prefix preserved, exactly 100 records appended; Decision Journal unchanged.

scope: One locked preparation only. Keyed by project/projection and checked artifact identity; reset before append even on failure. No cross-request reuse. Public one-off catalog queries retain targeted scanning.

checks.socket_check: Initial sandbox socket creation denied; scoped network rerun passed.
checks.coverage: Validation per entry, stale/invalid final entry atomic refusal, history preservation, one append/invalidation, first 32 witnesses, all-use count, duplicate operands, copy isolation, project/projection/artifact boundaries, failure cleanup and no repeated query resolution.

limits: Single local measurement, not a general throughput claim. Cold artifact construction (171.097s) excluded from both preparation timings. No renderer/native backend or target fact changes.
